checkpoints.name: Week 2 Data Quality Check
checkpoints.purpose: Confirm the Week 1 diagnostic produced enough evidence before committing Weeks 3-4 allocation.
evidenceRequired: At least one scored sample per available skill

checkpoints.name: Week 4 Target Feasibility Check
checkpoints.purpose: Decide whether the 8-week operating target remains Overall 8.0 / each skill 7.5+.

checkpoints.name: Week 6 Trajectory And Allocation Check
checkpoints.purpose: Compare Week 4 and Week 6 progress and reallocate time toward stalled skills.

checkpoints.name: Week 8 Final Lock-in
checkpoints.purpose: Finalize exam readiness, risk flags, and per-skill exam-day tactics.
